verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail sells TruLease (a commercial office with a one-year lease and an optional utility bill) and TruResidence (a verified U.S. residential address) alongside its mailbox and free registered agent, all from one provider. LLC formation, however, is only DIY guidance: TruStart offers videos and templates rather than a done-for-you filing service. Missing for 10: a done-for-you LLC formation/filing service, explicit documentation that TruLease supports foreign qualification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pair the address with entity services — LLC formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, or residency-grade addresses — from the same provider

citations.quote: When renting an office, you'll sign a one-year lease agreement that verifies your business has legal rights to the office space.
TruResidence (TruRes) provides you with a verified U.S. residential address, helping you maintain U.S. ties for personal accounts and receive mail online.
Self-paced videos to show you how to form an LLC, open a business bank account, and stay compliant with state taxes and laws.
Choose a plan that grows with you—whether you need a secure online mailbox, a home address for personal accounts, or a physical office address with lease agreements and utility bills
As your registered agent, VPM will receive service of process, legal notices, and other important state correspondences on your behalf. ... Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans.
